scorecard.proof: TestIngestPersistsCanonicalExperienceWithRedactionAndProvenance asserts a persisted .relia/experiences/YYYY-MM.jsonl record with relia.experience_record shape, attribution, provenance URLs, and redaction_status applied.
Known GitHub token shapes are redacted before persistence, and TestIngestFailsClosedBeforePersistenceForUnrecognizedSecret verifies unclassified high-entropy input exits 6 without creating a shard.
TestIngestRejectsExperienceWithoutProvenance verifies missing provenance exits 9 with a provenance_integrity_failed typed error.
TestIngestInfersAttributionAndUpsertsIdempotently verifies configured PR label attribution, deterministic experience IDs, inferred terminal state, and idempotent shard upsert.
TestIngestSkipsUncertainAttributionByDefault verifies attribution.uncertain: exclude skips uncertain outcomes instead of persisting them.
